vercel_runtime_evidence.interpretation: The sampled application failures were classified as database connection failures rather than local pool-wait timeouts.

supavisor_evidence.interpretation: Connection-handshake and connecting errors occurred in the same bounded observation window.

remediation.action: Restored the pre-experiment single shared IP rate-limit bucket implementation.
remediation.reason: The experimental partitioned IP buckets coincided with the failed burst, while the earlier implementation completed the prior full run without request errors.

assessment.confidence: high that the HTTP 503 responses were connection-class failures; medium that the burst exposed aggregate connection-handshake saturation
limits: The evidence does not prove an exact connection-cap exhaustion mechanism.
The aggregate number of active serverless instances and sockets was not directly observed.
The rate-limit rollback is a stability rollback, not proof that rate-limit partitioning alone caused the database connection failures.
No further remote burst was run after the rollback within this diagnostic task.
